The '''1905–06 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]]<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.rsssf.org/players/scot-champ-teams.html | title=Scotland - Championship Winning Teams 1900-1920 | access-date=July 3, 2011}}</ref> by six points over nearest rival [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]].
